scripts.lint:types: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.spec.json && tsc --noEmit -p wasm-tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.static: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:types && npm run dup && npm run deadcode && npm run audit && npm run deps:age
scripts.quality:self-test: npm run lint:probes && npm run test:lint-rules && npm run quality:probes && npm run hook:probes
scripts.verify:fast: npm run static && npm run test:rust && npm run wasm:build && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:ci
scripts.verify: npm run static && npm run quality:self-test && npm run test:rust && npm run test:rust:mutants && npm run wasm:build && npm run wasm:verify && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:ci && npm run build
scripts.rust:lint: node scripts/cargo.mjs fmt --check && node scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && node scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --lib --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
scripts.test:rust: npm run rust:lint && node scripts/cargo.mjs test
